currentRoundInspection.method: Two pictures inspected in browser and compared with standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke survey research or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observations: Faceted roofless shell keep on green motte. Taller square entrance projection, open stair approach, sparse slit/window groups, unequal crenellations and slender elevated stair turret. Low-frequency stone texture carries masonry.

Large irregular quadrangular enclosure; detached open keep/motte in the northwestern court; long inner dividing wall; western palace with multiple unequal square/polygonal towers, dark pitched roofs and slender turrets; tall southwest clock tower; south entrance and north/west gates; open broad lawns and southern visitor range. Trees and city remain host content.
